deploymentBlockerFound.issue: The documented Render health check path /api/health returns 403 over plaintext HTTP because the platform control plane mounts its HTTPS guard on /api ahead of the tenant health route
deploymentBlockerFound.consequence: Every Render deploy would have been marked unhealthy, since provider health probes are internal HTTP without X-Forwarded-Proto
deploymentBlockerFound.fix: Added /healthz outside /api, disclosing only reachability; render.yaml points at it
deploymentBlockerFound.verifiedBy: local production-mode boot: /healthz 200 over plain HTTP while /api refuses without forwarded TLS, demo credentials rejected, frontend served

productDefectsFixedInVerification: server/fundraising.js used the frontend local-date today() while every other server module and all recorded timestamps use UTC, so a user behind UTC in the evening could be told a same-day follow-up was in the future or that an acknowledgment preceded a finalization recorded minutes earlier
Provider callback routes mount before the /api HTTPS middleware and answered plaintext HTTP in production; all three now refuse it themselves
Anonymous unbounded growth in public_giving_returns and in the audit table could have destroyed the ability to produce a recovery archive
A donor reloading their own self-service link hit a uniqueness violation and a 500
Volunteer link replay evidence grew without a per-link ceiling
Remote model egress inherited permission from seed/demo mode and from whoever supplied the transport
scope: Local synthetic verification of source. Not buyer acceptance, not production operation, not certification, and not a predicted evaluation score.
limitations: Typed workbook, PDF and RTF exports are verified structurally in tests; no Excel, Acrobat or Word client runs in this environment, so rendering fidelity is unproved
Concurrency assertions run within one process because node:sqlite is synchronous; BEGIN IMMEDIATE and uniqueness constraints are the cross-process guard and are not multi-process proven
Model assistance selects records only on instances in synthetic data mode, and synthetic data mode reflects how the workspace database was initialised, not what it now holds
Alert transports, off-host log retention, key custody, backup cadence and residency placement are operational, not established by source
Focus placement after asynchronous actions is asserted to exist in code but was not observed firing under a screen reader
